title: No AI prompt knows who it is writing for, and Vera calls Frequency a revolution
detail:
PR 2 (ADR-1715). Adds the audience block (two readers, Builders, men through activities, spiritual and skeptic, supporters, never name an archetype or guess age, gender or feelings) to VOICE_PRIMER after the skeptic test, so every withVoice prompt carries it. Replaces Vera's default register line (This is a revolution and you say so) in lib/ai/vera/agent-claude.ts and docs/AI-VERA.md with conviction that never calls it a revolution. Wraps the support reply draft prompt (app/(main)/admin/support/actions.ts) and the demo palette prompt (lib/demo/ai-palette.ts) in withVoice. No dollar figures or percentages in the primer (marketing-figures.test.ts scans it).

CLOSED 2026-10-06. VOICE_PRIMER carries the audience block after the skeptic test; Vera's hot register points at what we replace and never calls it a revolution (code and docs/AI-VERA.md); the support reply draft and the demo palette prompts run through withVoice. agent-claude.test.ts asserts the block is in Vera's prompt and no affirmative revolution line is.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(p)=>{try{return fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8")}catch{return ""}};const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};if(!r("lib/ai/voice.ts").includes("Who you\u2019re writing for")&&!r("lib/ai/voice.ts").includes("Who you"+String.fromCharCode(39)+"re writing for"))fail("VOICE_PRIMER has no audience block, so no AI prompt knows its reader");if(/revolution and you say so/i.test(r("lib/ai/vera/agent-claude.ts")))fail("Vera system prompt still says this is a revolution");if(!/withVoice\(\s*DRAFT_SYSTEM/.test(r("app/(main)/admin/support/actions.ts")))fail("support reply drafts are written without withVoice");if(!/withVoice/.test(r("lib/demo/ai-palette.ts")))fail("demo palette copy is generated without withVoice")'
verify.note: Fails while VOICE_PRIMER lacks the audience block, Vera's prompt says revolution, or the support draft or demo palette prompt skip withVoice.
